disputeCvCoGas.description: Path 1->2->3->5->8->9->16. Scaling: requestToSubmitCv uses packedIndices with YY indices; submitCv runs YY txs; requestToSubmitCo sets indicesLength=ZZ and passes CvAndSigRS[] only for requested indices whose Cv is not on-chain (size = notOnChainAmongZZ) with packedVs sized to that count; generateRandomNumberWhenSomeCvsAreOnChain uses allSecrets[N], SigRS[] of length (N - onChainCvCount), and packedVs sized likewise. Gas increases with N, YY, ZZ and with how many Cvs remain off-chain.

disputeSecretsGas.description: Path 1->2->3->5->12->13. Scaling by k (_k_ZZ): requestToSubmitS consumes secretsReceivedOffchainInRevealOrder of length ZZ, derived from reveal order prefix; SigRS[] and packedVs are constructed only for operators whose Cv is not on-chain, so their lengths equal (N - onChainCvCount). submitS per k touches storage for that operator and enforces reveal-order checks. Gas grows with ZZ and with how many Cvs remain off-chain.

disputeSecretsReRequestGas.description: Path 1->2->3->5->12->13. Scaling by k (_k_ZZ): reRequestToSubmitS advances the reveal index and only passes the newly known secrets since the previous k, so secretsReceivedOffchainInRevealOrder length equals (ZZ - prevK). Storage and reveal-order checks are limited to the current k. Gas increases with ZZ and with remaining off-chain Cvs.

failToRequestSubmitCvOrSubmitMerkleRootG.description: Leader fail: Path 1->4. Varies by operators count. Period parameters (off-chain, decision windows) determine elapsed time; calldata is constant.

failToSubmitMerkleRootAfterDisputeGas.description: Leader fail: Path 1->2->3->7. Varies by operators count and number of Cvs submitted (all in this test). Gas depends on bitmap size and storage touched while penalizing after on-chain period.

failToRequestSorGenerateRandomNumberGas.description: Leader fail: Path 1->5->14. Varies by operators count. After all Cvs on-chain and MerkleRoot submitted, waiting windows scale with operator count; calldata fixed.

failToSubmitCvGas.description: Nodes fail: Path 1->2->3->6. Varies by operators count (XX), number of requested Cv (YY), and number who did not submit (ZZ). Larger YY/ZZ increase bitmaps/loops and deactivation/reactivation work, affecting gas.

failToSubmitCoGas.description: Nodes fail: Path 1->5->8->10. Varies by operators count (XX), requested Co (YY), and number who did not submit (ZZ). Parameter sizes (indices arrays, bitmaps) and storage updates scale with YY/ZZ, impacting gas.

failToSubmitSGas.description: Nodes fail: Path 1->5->12->13->15. Varies by operators count (XX), S-requested length (= requested_YY via k=n-YY), and number who did not submit (ZZ). As YY/ZZ change, calldata for secrets and touched storage scale, changing gas.
